question: Should the self-hostable software behind these offers get records of their own with self_hosted true, ranked after every hosted record: the OpenObserve Open Source edition (AGPL-3.0, free forever) and its Self-Hosted Enterprise edition (free up to 50 GB of ingestion a day), the Healthchecks.io server (BSD 3-clause) and the GoatCounter app?
why: The pricing and documentation pages of these vendors state the self-hosted terms, which the hosted records name only as the last resort; this is the same question as for n8n Community Edition, the Temporal server, the Inngest server and the cron-job.org daemon.
